parameters.help_en: The name of the MaxCompute project
parameters.name: project_name

parameters.help_en: The names of the returned resources. The names must start with the value specified by the prefix parameter. If the prefix parameter is set to a, the names of the returned resources must start with a

parameters.name: prefix

parameters.help_en: Specifies the marker after which the returned list begins
parameters.help_zh: 设定结果从marker之后按字母排序的第一个开始返回

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return on each page
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回的最大结果数
parameters.name: max_item
